card.name: Small words after solution or hypersensitivity
card.fires_on: Short linking words (from, to, or, were) right after a noun in preparation or contraindication text, such as 'protect the vial from' light or 'hypersensitivity to' a named drug. Also the word 'ually' in 'Visually inspect'.

modes.label: Protect from light
modes.description: The word 'from' after a solution or vial that must be protected from light.
modes.example: protect the vial<< from>> light. Do not freeze .

modes.label: Hypersensitivity to drug
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'severe hypersensitivity' before a named drug.
modes.example: Patients with severe hypersensitivity<< to>> isatuximab-irfc

modes.label: Visually inspect
modes.description: The ending 'ually' of 'Visually' at the start of inspection instructions.
modes.example: Preparation • Vis<<ually>> inspect drug product for particulate matter and
